```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"A recent increase to the capital city’s subway fare sparked a massive protest and resistance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The slogan “no es por los 30 pesos, es por los últimos 30 años” means “not for the 30 cents but for the last 30 years”.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This slogan references the three decades of neoliberalism and representative democracy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the demands of the Chilean left and progressive social movements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for ending military presence in the streets, including the first curfew since the dictatorship.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for stopping human rights violations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for addressing those who have been wrongly killed, hurt, and detained.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for beginning a dialogue between the government and civil society to address and find solutions to the problems that caused this social upheaval.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA and its predecessor groups have stood with the Chilean people during the junta.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA and its predecessor groups stand with the Chilean people today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
